text:
incident-bot: PAGED: PagerDuty alert fired for service=infra-inference-queue (high queue depth, autoscaler lag). page_id=PD12345 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident attached: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD12345 - priority: high - auto-escalation 5m
oncall-sre: acked. I'm on it. starting checklist.
ashley: acknowledging, watching dashboards. which cell?
oncall-sre: looks like us-west-2 / cell-7. queue depth jumped to ~18k in the last 3m, target replicas stayed flat. autoscaler metrics show scale_loop_latency ~45s.
ben: confirming requests piling on high-p99 latency for hosted inference routes. Some customers seeing 503s.
oncall-sre: copying logs, running `kubectl get hpa -n inference cell-7 -o yaml` now.
ops-automation: detected KV warmup miss for cell-7, suggested auto-burst spinup disabled due to quota. (reason: nodeQuotaExceeded)
miguel: can we manual-scale while we sort autoscaler? `kubectl scale deployment/worker-cell-7 --replicas=12` approved?
oncall-sre: yes do manual scale to 12, but be careful with spot limits. doing it in 30s.
ashley: doing manual scale now. `kubectl scale` output: scaled deployment "worker-cell-7" to 12 replicas.
ben: starting traffic-shed policy to reduce tail impact for non-SLAs. hitting the route-level fallback rule.
ops-automation: note: several queued inflight prefixes show cold-kv misses, heavy prefix fanout from a single customer keyspace (customer: megaflow-inc).
miguel: reaching out to megaflow account team in parallel, asking them to reduce burst if possible.
oncall-sre: autoscaler logs: "Scale loop iteration took 47s, desired_replicas unchanged due to provider quota error". attaching snippet: ```[2026-03-17T14:02:03Z] scale-controller ERROR: provider quota exceeded when provisioning nodes (code=QuotaExceeded)```
ashley: can we request temporary quota bump? I pinged infra-quotas slack and opened ticket with cloud support.
ben: manual scale succeeded, pods are starting, p95 latency trending down. queue depth dropping slowly.
oncall-sre: PagerDuty: adding escalation to platform-team after 10m if quota not resolved.
ops-automation: to-do: (1) keep manual replicas until autoscaler recovers, (2) enable burst-capacity policy once quota cleared, (3) add temp KV cache warmup for megaflow prefixes.
miguel: noted. I'll coordinate megaflow and confirm they throttle.
oncall-sre: marking incident as "mitigated" once queue depth <2k and p99 <1.5s. current: queue=6.1k, p99=2.8s.
ashley: adding follow-up runbook entry: scale-controller should surface provider quota errors to oncall more clearly. filing a GH issue.
ben: thumbs up. leaving monitoring alerts on. if PD re-fires escalate to oncall-2.
oncall-sre: ack, handing off to follow-up (post-incident) owner: ashley. closing on-call thread in ~30m, will update incident timeline in PD. :white_check_mark:
